newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rio Tinto to base research in Melbourne.
newsitem.headline: Rio Tinto to base research in Melbourne.

text.p: International resources group Rio Tinto Ltd said on Thursday that after a global review the company had decided to base its research and technology development operations in the Australian city of Melbourne.
The company said the decision followed a review in March which determined the company should remain at the leading edge of best practice in research and technology.
"The unit is to have global responsibility for Rio Tinto's corporate research and development and will be supported by world class facilities in Melbourne and Perth," the company said in a statement.
The company said the unit would focus corporate research efforts into a number of core areas, notably process development, environmental management technology and knowledge-based information systems.

A number of activities previously managed outside Australia would be transferred to the new research unit, which would also be responsible for leading collaborative research efforts with universities and research centres in Australia and around the world, the company said.
